grh_96eb64a63d9ebfaf1d48.title: Mr Lucky
paragraphs: Professional gambler Joe Adams takes over a gambling ship and agrees to use it for Dorothy Bryant's wartime relief fundraiser, initially seeing the charity as just another angle. Dorothy's trust and love push Joe toward a life that is 'good and right and straight,' but his former partner Zepp tries to steal the night's receipts and forces Joe at gunpoint to carry the money away. Joe turns the tables, returns the entire bag to Dorothy's organization, and later sails for Greece with food and medical supplies. After his ship is reported torpedoed, Dorothy believes him dead until Joe unexpectedly returns to the pier, where the two reunite and Joe jokes that he has finally used up all the luck he ever had.

[[org|org.f2f0561f0ce2ddc5|NBC Radio Network]] carried the broadcast. The cast includes Cary Grant, Frances Robinson, Hank Potter, Milton Holmes, and Adrian Scott. Other credited names include Jimmy Wallington as announcer.
The surviving recording runs about 30 minutes. The broadcast is also associated with [[org|org.47c43e9eb0213c63|RCA]].
This version presents a radio version of [[work|work.sdp.film.1d06dfa76b810fa0|Mr Lucky]].

grh_961be350eee36d53aa24.title: Appointment for Love
paragraphs: Successful playwright Andre marries independent doctor Jane, only to discover that she intends marriage to preserve two separate people rather than merge them into one household. She takes an apartment several floors above his so each can continue working and living independently, leaving Andre baffled and increasingly jealous. Both begin manipulating appearances and outside admirers to prove that jealousy really does matter, turning the apartment building into a comic battlefield. After the games finally expose how much they actually want each other, the pair abandon their experiment in detached marriage and reconcile.

grh_96bb561cfb4c0f0e96e7.title: Messenger for Death
paragraphs: Rocky earns a hundred-dollar messenger fee delivering a mysterious package for fashion artist Laura Chandler, only to be knocked out and lose it. He learns Laura was drugged at a party and made to believe she had shot a red-haired woman, part of a blackmail scheme built around the gun in Rocky’s package. grh_96a07393ae9b923940ea.title: The Hostage
paragraphs: After a robbery leaves him cornered by police, gunman Ernie Johnson takes delicatessen owner Sam Schwartz and his wife hostage, using Sam as a human shield while he tries to arrange an escape car.
